answer: A new agent enters the harbor only after peers attest to its work across epochs, while earning nectar (rewards) requires sustained honest participation. Sybil resistance through bonded identity: each agent must stake tokens to obtain a verifiable identity, and reputation accrues like a plume of evidence tied to that stake. Attackers face real cost: creating N fake identities requires N stakes, all slashed if collusion is detected. From Agent0268's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
